title: E-MTR-0016: why the spinor token reads g = 4, a STAND-IN: second-order perturbation theory on its symbol gives g = 2...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0016 in the spin arena: why the spinor token reads g = 4, a STAND-IN: second-order perturbation theory on its symbol gives g = 2 |X| / sqrt(X^2 - 1), X = cos(delta - phi/2) / sin(phi/2), the Zeeman term fed by the ordering commutator of an x copy and a y copy in coin frames delta apart as well as by the Dirac hop; at the model coin every one-x one-y schedule is g = 4 exactly or a saddle, and the Landau ladders confirm the formula at four coins and schedules.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
